record.narrative:
All returned estimates are already signed to the registered hypothesis direction. For dependency_composite, acceptance requires a signed effect above 0.15 composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction with uncertainty supporting a threshold-level effect. These were amplification-interaction tests: a positive signed estimate indicates the accepted association is stronger in the high-state subgroup than in its complement, whereas a negative signed estimate indicates attenuation relative to the complement.

High MYC expression H120-H123 does not support amplification of the four accepted associations. H120 gives R106 signed -0.057 with interval -0.213 to +0.099; this is small and opposite the amplification claim. H121 gives R107 signed +0.128 with interval -0.009 to +0.265; the point estimate is below threshold, the interval includes null, and the evidence does not establish a threshold-level amplification. H122 gives R108 signed +0.080 with interval -0.080 to +0.240, null and below threshold. H123 gives R109 signed +0.083 with interval -0.173 to +0.340, also null; the high-MYC MSI-high exposed cell has 31 observations, above the minimum but too sparse and imprecise to support a context claim. All four amplification hypotheses are rejected and closed.

High IFN-gamma signature H132-H135 similarly does not support context-dependent amplification. H132 gives R110 signed +0.027 with interval -0.097 to +0.152, essentially null. H133 gives R111 signed -0.050 with interval -0.174 to +0.074, opposite direction and null. H134 gives R112 signed -0.064 with interval -0.194 to +0.067, opposite direction and null. H135 gives R113 signed +0.069 with interval -0.180 to +0.318, null and imprecise in rare MSI-high cells. All four are rejected and closed.

High growth-rate doublings per day H136-H139 also do not support amplification. H136 gives R114 signed -0.127 with interval -0.267 to +0.013. The negative sign is opposite the registered amplification claim and may suggest attenuation of the SMARCA4 association in high-growth cells relative to lower-growth cells, but the point magnitude is below the 0.15 threshold and the interval crosses null, so this is not threshold-level confirmatory evidence of either amplification or attenuation. H137 gives R115 signed +0.076 with interval -0.062 to +0.215, below threshold and null. H138 gives R116 signed -0.051 with interval -0.193 to +0.092, opposite direction and null. H139 gives R117 signed +0.086 with interval -0.161 to +0.334, below threshold and null. All four are rejected and closed.

Overall, the mature accepted dataset-specific associations remain robust to these additional context axes rather than being modified by them. No result provides a threshold-supported amplification effect in the claimed direction. The only mildly notable signal is the H136 attenuation-direction result, but it is below the required magnitude, interval-crossing, and post hoc relative to the registered hypothesis; therefore it is not accepted and not validated. No validation is requested because there is no discovery claim in the claimed direction that is large and interval-supported, and validating borderline or opposite-direction exploratory interaction signals would add multiplicity without a justified target.

prompt:
Iteration 9/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

Assessment due: H106 concerns MSI-high status among samples with mutation_burden <= 7.5, claimed in the direction of stronger dependency. Discovery R80 was signed +0.803 with 95% interval +0.644 to +0.961. The scheduled independent validation R92 is signed +0.860 with independent interval +0.509 to +1.212, valid cells 32 versus 1336. Because H106 direction is -1, positive signed estimates correspond to raw lower dependency_composite values, i.e. stronger measured dependency. The validation lower bound is well above the 0.15 composite-unit threshold, and both discovery and validation are concordant and far from threshold. Therefore I accept H106 and close the investigation. This strengthens, rather than undermines, the mature MSI-high association: MSI-high samples show stronger dependency in the globally accepted main-effect analyses and specifically in the lower-mutation-burden subgroup.

Final scientific report on current evidence. All returned estimates and intervals are already signed to the registered hypothesis direction; they were not re-signed by me. The effect-size threshold for dependency_composite is 0.15 composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction. These are associations in the supplied dataset only; they do not establish causal mechanism or biological generalizability.

Supported dataset-specific associations. 1) SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger dependency. The accepted claims use direction -1, so signed positive estimates correspond to raw lower dependency scores. Evidence includes the main association R3/R13 and robustness claims across TP53-intact samples R14/R40, SMARCA4-intact-restricted TP53 loss R15, matched omics/CRISPR QC R16, adenocarcinoma R93/R95 context, Avana library R24, and high screen-quality R37. The effect is roughly 0.76-0.84 composite units and remains far above threshold. 2) TP53 loss is associated with weaker dependency. The accepted claims use direction +1, so signed positive estimates correspond to raw higher dependency scores. Evidence includes R1/R26, TP53-intact-restricted SMARCA4 loss complement R15, QC subset R17, Avana subset R25, high screen-quality subset R38, and adenocarcinoma subset R94. The effect is approximately 0.82-0.84 units. 3) KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker dependency. Accepted direction +1 evidence includes main R20/R39, TP53-intact R31, QC R27, Avana R28, high screen-quality R29, non-Avana R30, and adenocarcinoma R95. The effect is approximately 0.78-0.88 units. 4) MSI-high is associated with stronger dependency. Accepted direction -1 evidence includes main R73/R78, lower mutation burden R80/R92, higher mutation burden R81, TP53-intact R82, high screen-quality R83, and adenocarcinoma R96. The effect is approximately 0.71-0.87 units. The accepted findings are internally consistent across many robustness strata and do not depend on a single technical subgroup.

Negative or null findings. STK11 loss was not supported after validation: discovery R2 was null and validation R79 was signed +0.062 with interval crossing null and below threshold. No meaningful main association was found for KRAS mutation, MYC amplification, ARID1A loss, MTAP loss, RB1 loss, EGFR amplification, ERBB2 amplification, PIK3CA mutation, APC mutation, SMAD4 loss, NF1 loss, BRCA2 loss, research markers D/E/F, sex, media-serum contrast 10 versus 5, or the tested technical/QC main contrasts. Context amplification interaction screens were consistently null or below threshold for lineage subtype, research signature A, research signature C, mutual TP53/SMARCA4/KEAP1 interactions, screen quality, mutation burden, aneuploidy, EMT, hypoxia, stemness, Cas9 activity, high MYC expression, high IFN-gamma signature, and high growth-rate doublings per day. A few opposite-direction or near-threshold interaction signals, such as TP53 high MYC expression signed +0.128, SMARCA4 high growth rate signed -0.127, and MSI-high high AXL signed -0.179, are not accepted because they are below threshold, interval-crossing, or not in the registered amplification direction. They are post hoc signals only, not context-dependence claims.

Unresolved uncertainty. PTEN remains borderline and not accepted: main effect signed +0.239 has lower bound +0.145, just below threshold; TP53-intact discovery and validation are supportive but the latter lower bound is +0.113, below threshold; the narrow high-quality TP53-intact Avana/high-ROC stratum failed validation. CDKN2A also remains unresolved and not accepted: main signed +0.139 is below threshold, and strata are generally below threshold. Exact numeric continuous main-effect comparisons were technically invalid because cells fell below minimum cell-size requirements, so they provide neither support nor contradiction. PTEN and CDKN2A should not be further mined by additional strata unless a new threshold-supported signal emerges.

Most informative next analysis. Externally, the highest-value next step would be independent replication of the four mature associations: SMARCA4 loss toward stronger dependency, TP53 loss toward weaker dependency, KEAP1 loss toward weaker dependency, and MSI-high toward stronger dependency. Within this dataset, the best focused follow-up is not more PTEN or CDKN2A stratum mining and not chasing the weak opposite-direction interaction signals. I registered four pre-specified interaction screens testing whether an above-baseline copy_number_8q24 state, copy_number_8q24 >= 0.0, amplifies the four accepted associations. Each claim uses the same direction as the accepted main association for that predictor, so a positive signed estimate above 0.15 would support amplification in the high-copy-number state relative to its complement. If all are null or below threshold, this will further support robustness of the mature associations. If a threshold-level opposite-direction signal appears, it should not be accepted as attenuation unless a separate confirmatory attenuation hypothesis and validation support it. No new validation is needed at this synthesis step because H106 now has independent validation and no new discovery claim yet requires validation.

prompt:
Iteration 10/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

Iteration 10/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

record.narrative: All newly delivered results are interaction amplification tests for the four mature dataset-specific associations, with estimates already signed to each registered hypothesis direction. For the direction -1 SMARCA4-loss and MSI-high claims, a positive signed interaction above +0.15 would mean the accepted stronger-dependency association is amplified in the designated high/low genomic-state subgroup relative to its complement; for the direction +1 TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss claims, a positive signed interaction above +0.15 would mean the accepted weaker-dependency association is amplified. None of the 12 tested interactions provides threshold-supported amplification evidence. The 8q24 copy-number screen is null overall: H140 gives -0.030 with interval -0.158 to +0.098; H141 gives +0.117 with interval -0.009 to +0.242, below threshold and interval-crossing; H142 gives +0.032 with interval -0.099 to +0.162; H143 gives -0.160 with interval -0.385 to +0.065, opposite the registered amplification direction and not interval-supported. The low-9p21 copy-number screen is also null: H144 through H147 have point estimates from +0.008 to +0.104 with intervals spanning zero and none reaching the +0.15 threshold. The high-ploidy screen is likewise null: H148 gives +0.083 with interval -0.063 to +0.230; H149 gives +0.085 with interval -0.072 to +0.242; H150 gives -0.047 with interval -0.297 to +0.202. The completed TP53 high-aneuploidy test H91 gives +0.084 with interval -0.058 to +0.225, below threshold and interval-crossing. From a critical-review perspective, these tests do not suffer from invalid cells, but the family-wise multiplicity is substantial and none of the estimates survives even the ordinary discovery interval criterion in the claimed direction. Near-threshold or opposite-sign values such as H141 and H143 are not accepted as attenuation or amplification claims because their intervals include null and their interpretations would be post hoc relative to the registered hypotheses. These results therefore strengthen robustness of the mature dataset-specific associations—SMARCA4 loss toward stronger dependency, TP53 loss toward weaker dependency, KEAP1 loss toward weaker dependency, and MSI-high toward stronger dependency—rather than identifying supported context modification by copy_number_8q24, copy_number_9p21, ploidy, or aneuploidy. No validation is requested because there is no new claim that is both threshold-supported and interval-supported in the registered direction.

prompt:
Iteration 10/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess new validation and any response deadlines listed below. Explain what you conclude and what to investigate next. Accepted claims update automatically.

record.narrative:
H87 response deadline and new validation: H87 tested PTEN loss in the claimed direction of stronger dependency among TP53-intact, Avana-library, high-screen-quality samples. Discovery R54 was signed +0.195 (95% +0.067 to +0.323), with a point estimate above the 0.15 threshold but an interval lower bound below threshold. The independent validation R105 was much smaller and uncertain: +0.085 (independent interval -0.101 to +0.271), below the scientific threshold and crossing null. I therefore reject H87 and close that narrow PTEN stratum. This failure reduces support for any threshold-level PTEN association and argues against further PTEN stratum mining; it does not affect the mature accepted associations.

Final scientific report on current evidence. All estimates and intervals are already signed to the registered hypothesis direction and were not re-signed by me. The outcome-specific meaningful-effect threshold is an absolute difference of 0.15 composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction. These are dataset-specific associations only, not causal or generalizable claims.

Supported dataset-specific associations. 1) SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger dependency. The accepted direction is -1, so positive signed estimates correspond to raw lower dependency scores. Evidence includes the main association R3/R13 and robustness/strata evidence including TP53-intact samples R14/R40, matched omics/CRISPR QC R16, Avana library R24, high screen quality R37, and adenocarcinoma R93. The signed effect is roughly 0.76 to 0.84 composite units, far above threshold and validated. 2) TP53 loss is associated with weaker dependency. The accepted direction is +1, so positive signed estimates correspond to raw higher dependency scores. Evidence includes main R1/R26 and strata/robustness evidence R15, R17, R25, R38, and R94. The effect is approximately 0.82 to 0.84 units. 3) KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker dependency. The accepted direction is +1. Evidence includes main R20/R39 and strata/robustness evidence R31, R27, R28, R29, R30, and R95. The effect is approximately 0.78 to 0.88 units. 4) MSI-high is associated with stronger dependency. The accepted direction is -1. Evidence includes main R73/R78 and strata/robustness evidence R80/R92, R81, R82, R83, and R96. The effect is approximately 0.71 to 0.87 units. These four mature claims are internally consistent and supported by independent validation where available.

Negative or null findings. STK11 loss was not supported after validation: discovery R2 was null and validation R79 remained below threshold with an interval crossing null. No meaningful main association was found for KRAS mutation, MYC amplification, ARID1A loss, MTAP loss, RB1 loss, EGFR amplification, ERBB2 amplification, PIK3CA mutation, APC mutation, SMAD4 loss, NF1 loss, BRCA2 loss, research markers D/E/F, sex main contrast, media-serum 10 versus 5, or the tested technical/QC main contrasts. The completed interaction screens were consistently null, below threshold, or not interval-supported in the registered direction: lineage subtype, research signatures, mutual TP53/SMARCA4/KEAP1 interactions, screen quality, mutation burden, EMT, hypoxia, stemness, Cas9 activity, MYC expression, IFN-gamma signature, AXL expression, copy_number_8q24, copy_number_9p21, ploidy, and aneuploidy. Near-threshold or opposite-sign interaction values, such as TP53 high MYC expression signed +0.128, SMARCA4 high growth-rate signed -0.127, and MSI-high high AXL signed -0.179, are not accepted because they are below threshold, interval-crossing, or not in the registered amplification direction. They are post hoc signals only, not context-dependence claims.

Unresolved uncertainty. PTEN remains borderline and not accepted. The main H24 discovery has a point estimate above threshold but a lower bound just below threshold, and related strata validations do not robustly support a threshold-level effect. H40 TP53-intact PTEN has discovery lower above threshold but validation lower below threshold; H87 has now failed independent validation; and H94 remains narrow and unvalidated. CDKN2A also remains unresolved and not accepted: main signed effect is below threshold and strata are generally below threshold. Exact continuous main-effect tests with too-few cells were invalid and provide neither support nor contradiction.

Most informative next analysis. The mature associations have been broadly validated and context screening for copy-number, ploidy, mutation burden, expression, and quality factors is now largely null. I therefore registered a small pre-specified completion screen for two additional context axes: adherent culture type and sex. The culture tests complete the adherence interaction set alongside active H99/H100 for SMARCA4 and KEAP1; the sex tests evaluate whether the four mature associations are context-modified in males versus females. Iteration 11/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.

Iteration 11/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep

Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

record.narrative:
The 12 new results are context-interaction tests for the four mature dataset-specific associations, all signed to the registered amplification direction. A positive signed estimate above 0.15 with interval support would have indicated that the accepted association is stronger in the designated context than in its complement. Most tests are clearly unsupported: H99 (SMARCA4 loss in adherent culture) is +0.031 (-0.107 to +0.169); H151 (TP53 loss in adherent culture) is -0.043 (-0.187 to +0.100); H153 (SMARCA4 loss in males) is +0.064 (-0.066 to +0.193); H154 (TP53 loss in males) is -0.039 (-0.164 to +0.085); H155 (KEAP1 loss in males) is +0.029 (-0.104 to +0.162); H156 (MSI-high in males) is +0.118 (-0.104 to +0.340); H157 (SMARCA4 loss in high-serum media) is -0.045 (-0.174 to +0.084); H158 (TP53 loss in high-serum media) is +0.038 (-0.090 to +0.166); and H160 (MSI-high in high-serum media) is -0.062 (-0.281 to +0.158). None is threshold-supported in the claimed direction, and several intervals also cross or lie near null. Therefore I reject these context-amplification claims and close them.

H100 (KEAP1 loss in adherent culture) is borderline but not acceptable as a discovery claim: signed estimate +0.162, interval +0.008 to +0.317. The point estimate exceeds 0.15 and the interval nominally excludes zero, but the lower bound is far below the scientific threshold, and this test is part of a broad multiplicity family. Under multiplicity and threshold uncertainty, this is not sufficient to accept context amplification; I reject H100.

H152 (MSI-high in adherent culture) is the only threshold-ambiguous positive result: signed estimate +0.368, interval +0.137 to +0.599. The point estimate is well above 0.15 and the interval excludes null in the claimed direction, but the interval lower bound falls slightly below the threshold. This is potentially important context modification, but the exposed-complement MSI-high cell is small (29 observations), culture type may be correlated with lineage or culture-state variables, and multiple context comparisons have been run. Therefore I do not accept it yet. I request independent validation of H152; the current status remains unresolved and active pending that validation.

Evidence includes the main association R3/R13 and robustness/strata evidence including TP53-intact samples R14/R40, matched omics/CRISPR QC R16, Avana library R24, high screen quality R37, and adenocarcinoma R93. record.narrative: The due validation resolves H152. H152 tested whether the accepted MSI-high association toward stronger dependency is amplified in adherent culture relative to non-adherent conditions, with estimates signed to the MSI-high amplification direction. Discovery R133 was positive but threshold-ambiguous: signed +0.368, 95% +0.137 to +0.599; the point exceeds 0.15 but the interval lower bound does not. Independent validation R142 did not support threshold-level amplification: signed +0.116, independent interval -0.355 to +0.587. The validation estimate is below the 0.15 threshold and the interval crosses null. Therefore I reject H152 and close the adherent-culture MSI-high context claim. This failure does not weaken the mature main MSI-high association; it indicates that the dataset does not robustly support adherence-dependent modification of that association at the threshold. I also reassess and reject H161. H161 was a post hoc reversed/attenuation candidate for KEAP1 loss under high-serum media, derived from the opposite-direction interaction observed in H159. Its available discovery evidence R140 was signed +0.173 with interval +0.044 to +0.303 for the attenuation direction. Although the point estimate exceeds threshold, the lower bound is well below 0.15, the proposal was generated after observing an opposite-direction multiple-comparison signal, and no independent validation has confirmed it. Therefore H161 is not accepted and is closed as an unsupported post hoc signal. Final synthesis on current evidence, with all estimates signed to their registered directions: Four mature dataset-specific associations are supported. SMARCA4 loss is associated with stronger dependency; accepted direction is negative, and positive signed estimates around 0.76 to 0.84 correspond to lower, more negative dependency scores. This is supported by the main and validated comparison and is robust across TP53-intact, matched omics/CRISPR QC, Avana library, high screen ROC, and adenocarcinoma subsets. TP53 loss is associated with weaker dependency; accepted direction is positive, signed estimates around 0.82 to 0.84, and this is supported by main validated evidence and robustness strata. KEAP1 loss is associated with weaker dependency; accepted direction is positive, signed estimates around 0.78 to 0.88, supported by main validated evidence and multiple strata. MSI-high is associated with stronger dependency; accepted direction is negative, signed estimates around 0.71 to 0.87, supported by main validated evidence and robustness strata. These are associations in this supplied dataset only, not causal statements or claims of generalizability. Negative findings are broad: STK11 loss remains null after validation; KRAS, MYC amplification, ARID1A, MTAP, RB1, EGFR amplification, ERBB2 amplification, PIK3CA, APC, SMAD4, NF1, BRCA2, research markers D/E/F, sex main contrast, media-serum contrasts, and tested technical/QC main contrasts do not reach threshold-level support. Interaction screens for lineage subtype, research signatures, mutual predictor interactions, screen quality, mutation burden, EMT, hypoxia, stemness, Cas9 activity, MYC expression, AXL expression, IFN-gamma signature, copy-number variables, ploidy, aneuploidy, adherent culture, male sex, and high-serum media are mostly null, below threshold, or not interval-supported in the registered direction. Near-threshold or opposite-sign interaction values are treated as post hoc signals, not accepted context effects. Unresolved uncertainty remains for PTEN and CDKN2A: PTEN has borderline positive point estimates but no robust threshold-interval support and failed independent validation in a narrow stratum; CDKN2A main and stratum effects are generally below threshold. These remain unsupported rather than accepted. The most informative next analysis is not further exploratory subgroup mining in this dataset. Priority should be independent external replication and experimental validation of the four mature associations, ideally with perturbational designs to test causality and mechanism. If additional internal analysis is required, it should be limited to pre-specified robust modeling or replication of the few borderline PTEN/CDKN2A effects without further post hoc threshold fishing.

Iteration 12/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.
